title: 4 x 4 matrix multiplication in characteristic 0, number of multiplications
statement: Find a bilinear algorithm that multiplies two 4 x 4 matrices with non-commuting entries over the rationals (or the Gaussian rationals) with as few multiplications as possible. The catalogue's best is 48 (credited to Novikov et al., AlphaEvolve, 2025; its explicit algorithm has rational coefficients); 47 is known only over GF(2) (Fawzi et al., 2022) and does not count here.
submission: JSON {"field": F, "terms": [[U, V, W], ...]}: F is "Q", "Q(i)" or "GF(p)"; U is N x M, V is M x P and W is N x P, lists of rows; entries are integers or strings "a/b" (over Q(i) also pairs [re, im]); product r is (sum U_r[i][j] A[i][j]) (sum V_r[j][k] B[j][k]) and C[i][k] = sum_r W_r[i][k] times product r.
score: R, the number of multiplications (smaller is better)

best_known.source: <4x4x4:48>: Novikov et al. (AlphaEvolve 2025), in A. Sedoglavic's catalogue of fast matrix multiplication algorithms (fmm.univ-lille.fr, version 1c55fea), whose explicit algorithm has rational coefficients; read 9 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: A. Sedoglavic, Yet another catalogue of fast matrix multiplication algorithms
